extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. Teach: (1) Animals are all around us — dogs, cats, cows, goats, birds. (2) Each animal has its own sound — dogs bark, cats meow, cows moo, goats bleat. (3) Mammals have fur, birds have feathers. (4) Mammals have 4 legs, birds have 2 legs and 2 wings. (5) Pets live with us, street animals live on their own. Misconceptions: "all animals make the same sound" (each has its own sound), "birds have fur" (birds have feathers, mammals have fur), "all animals are pets" (pets live with us, street animals live on their own). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AnimalsGame), NOT export default. Export interface AnimalsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
